items.title: Ramadan Begins Today as Saudi Arabia Confirms Crescent Moon Sighting
items.desc: Saudi Arabia confirmed the sighting of the crescent moon, marking the official start of Ramadan 1447 on February 18, 2026. Muslims worldwide begin the month-long fasting period.
items.desc_zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯確認觀測到新月，2026年齋戒月（Ramadan 1447）於2月18日正式開始，全球穆斯林開始為期一個月的齋戒。

items.title: Tarique Rahman Sworn In as Bangladesh Prime Minister
items.desc: Tarique Rahman officially became the Prime Minister of Bangladesh on February 17, 2026, marking the beginning of a new political era for the country after BNP's landslide victory.
items.desc_zh: Tarique Rahman 於2026年2月17日正式成為孟加拉國總理，標誌著該國政治新時代的開始。

items.title: Iran-US Talks: Agreement Reached on 'Guiding Principles' After Constructive Meeting
items.title_zh: 伊朗-美國會談：建設性會議後就「指導原則」達成協議
items.desc: Iran described the latest round of indirect talks with the US as 'more constructive' than the previous set earlier this month. Agreement was reached on 'general guiding principles' that could lead to a further meeting.
items.desc_zh: 伊朗形容與美國的最新一輪間接會談比本月初的會談「更具建設性」。雙方就「一般指導原則」達成協議，可能促成進一步會議。

items.title: India and France Establish 'Special Global Strategic Partnership'
items.title_zh: 印度與法國建立「特殊全球戰略夥伴關係」
items.desc: India and France elevated their bilateral ties to a 'Special Global Strategic Partnership' during Macron's three-day visit. The two sides announced 21 outcomes spanning defence, critical minerals, high technology, and renewable energy.
items.desc_zh: 印度和法國在馬克龍三天訪問期間將雙邊關係提升為「特殊全球戰略夥伴關係」。雙方宣布了涵蓋國防、關鍵礦產、高科技和可再生能源的21項成果。

items.title: Saks Global Files for Bankruptcy Protection
items.desc: Saks Global, the parent company behind Saks Fifth Avenue, Neiman Marcus and Bergdorf Goodman, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection after an unsustainable debt pile crushed its business.
items.desc_zh: Saks Global（薩克斯第五大道、Neiman Marcus和Bergdorf Goodman的母公司）在無法承受的債務壓垮其業務後申請第十一章破產保護。

items.title: China's 2026 Real Estate Policy: Control Supply, Reduce Inventory, Optimize Provision
items.title_zh: 2026年中國房地產政策：控增量、去库存、优供给
items.desc: The Central Economic Work Conference placed 'stabilizing the real estate market' as a priority. Key measures include controlling new supply, reducing inventory, and optimizing housing provision. Distressed developers like Sunac and Country Garden are emerging from debt restructuring.
items.desc_zh: 中央經濟工作會議將「穩定房地產市場」置於優先位置，關鍵措施包括控增量、去库存、优供给。融創、碧桂園等出險房企正從債務重組中走出。

items.title: Local Government Work Reports Set 2026 GDP Growth Targets at 5% or Above
items.title_zh: 地方政府工作報告設定2026年GDP增長目標5%或以上
items.desc: Most provinces set 2026 GDP growth targets at 5% or above, with Tibet targeting over 7%. Key focuses include stabilizing real estate, urban renewal, housing security, and building 'good houses'.
items.desc_zh: 大多數省份將2026年GDP增長目標設定在5%或以上，西藏目標超過7%。重點包括穩定房地產、城市更新、住房保障和建設「好房子」。

items.title: Hong Kong Stock Market Closed for Lunar New Year Holiday Until Feb 24
items.title_zh: 港股農曆新年假期休市至2月24日
items.desc: The Hong Kong Stock Exchange is closed from February 15 to February 23 for the Lunar New Year holiday. Trading will resume on February 24. Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect services are also suspended.
items.desc_zh: 香港聯交所2月15日至2月23日因農曆新年假期休市，2月24日恢復交易。滬港通服務亦暫停。

sections.title: 📈 港股關注 - 萬國數據 GDS

items.title: GDS Holdings Expects Higher 2026 Bookings Driven by Strong AI Demand in China
items.title_zh: 萬國數據預計2026年預訂增長 受中國AI需求推動
items.desc: GDS Holdings expects higher bookings in 2026 driven by strong AI demand in China. The company plans its first REIT asset injection in Q2 2026 involving assets valued at 4-6 billion RMB.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據預計2026年預訂量將增長，受中國強勁AI需求推動。公司計劃2026年第二季度進行首次REIT資產注入，涉及資產價值約40-60億元人民幣。

items.title: Security Experts Warn About OpenClaw AI Agent Risks
items.title_zh: 安全專家警告OpenClaw AI代理風險
items.desc: Fortune reports that security experts are concerned about OpenClaw's risks. Permission misconfigurations could accidentally give OpenClaw more authority than users realize, allowing attackers to exploit the system.
items.desc_zh: 《財富》雜誌報導，安全專家對OpenClaw風險表示擔憂。權限配置錯誤可能意外給予OpenClaw過多權限，讓攻擊者有機可乘。

items.title: Personal AI Agents like OpenClaw Are a Security Nightmare
items.title_zh: 像OpenClaw這樣的個人AI代理是安全噩夢
items.desc: Cisco reports that OpenClaw can run shell commands, read and write files, and execute scripts. It has already been reported to have leaked plaintext API keys and credentials. 26% of 31,000 agent skills analyzed contained at least one vulnerability.
items.desc_zh: 思科報告指出，OpenClaw可以運行shell命令、讀寫文件和執行腳本。已有報告稱其洩露了明文API密鑰和憑證。分析的31,000個代理技能中26%至少包含一個漏洞。

items.title: AI Memory Shortage Crisis: Cook Warns It Will Compress iPhone Margins
items.title_zh: AI記憶體短缺危機：庫克警告將壓縮iPhone利潤率
items.desc: Tech leaders including Tim Cook and Elon Musk are warning about a global memory chip shortage. Cook warned it will compress iPhone margins. Micron called the bottleneck 'unprecedented.'
items.desc_zh: 包括蒂姆·庫克和埃隆·馬斯克在內的科技領袖正在警告全球記憶體芯片短缺。庫克警告這將壓縮iPhone利潤率。美光稱這一瓶頸「前所未有」。
